subject: maths
question: A, B and C can do a piece of work in 3, 6 and 10 days, respectively. How long (in days) will they take to do thrice the same work, working together?
solution:
**Given:**

Time by A = 3 days

Time by B = 6 days

Time by C = 10 days

Work = 3 times

**Formula Used:**

Efficiency = Total work ÷ Time

Time = Work ÷ Total efficiency
